item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Israel Expands Lebanon Offensive; Trump’s Oil-Route Demands Draw Cool Response
item.summary: The Israeli military said that it was escalating ground attacks against Iran-backed Hezbollah. China and other nations reacted tepidly to President Trump’s call for warships to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: In Iraq, the U.S. Tried to Bring Allies on Board. Not in Iran.
item.summary: This time, President Trump went to war without preparing the public, seeking U.N. approval or even consulting allies. But they will have to pick up the pieces.

item.title: As Rockets Fly Overhead, Residents of Israel’s Border City Stay Underground
item.summary: The Israeli government evacuated Kiryat Shmona during the last round of fighting with Hezbollah in 2023. Residents who were told it was safe to return are again under fire.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Sunday
item.summary: Five missiles struck the Baghdad International Airport and injured four people. Israeli and Iranian attacks continued as global economic concerns about the war mounted.

item.title: The Iran War’s Global Reach
item.summary: The fighting is raising energy prices, hitting farmers and reshaping geopolitics. We look at the ripple effects worldwide.

item.title: Pakistani-Afghan War Takes Heavy Toll on Civilians
item.summary: Pakistani airstrikes have killed at least 75 civilians and displaced 115,000 in Afghanistan, with both sides vowing escalation and no talks in sight.

item.title: Nordic Leaders Praise Carney as They Discuss Arctic Security
item.summary: Canada’s prime minister got a warm welcome from leaders still smarting about President Trump’s remarks two months ago about taking over Greenland.

item.title: 4 Palestinians Killed When Israeli Forces Open Fire on West Bank Family
item.summary: Six members of a Palestinian family went out for a ride in the car. Only two made it back home.

item.title: Trump’s Threat to Delay Summit With Xi Casts New Shadow Over China Relations
item.summary: President Trump warned that he could postpone a meeting set to begin in just over two weeks if China refuses to help reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Intrigue, Power Plays and Rivalries: Inside the Rise of Mojtaba Khamenei
item.summary: The weeklong fight over Iran’s next leader pitted the Revolutionary Guards against moderates. The generals won, but only over spirited resistance.
